vintage: Interior Ministry crime 2025; current school directory; INSEE BPE 2024

lenses.name: Burglaries
lenses.description: Recorded home burglaries per 100 residents in 2025. Police/gendarmerie recording and reporting propensity vary by territory.

lenses.name: Physical violence
lenses.description: Recorded non-domestic physical violence per 100 residents in 2025. This is recorded crime, not victimization prevalence.

lenses.name: Vehicle theft
lenses.description: Recorded vehicle thefts per 100 residents in 2025. Recorded crime reflects reporting propensity and police recording practices as well as offending.

lenses.name: Payment fraud
lenses.description: Recorded fraud and fraudulent use of payment methods per 100 residents in 2025. Recorded crime reflects reporting propensity and police recording practices as well as offending.

lenses.name: Drug trafficking
lenses.description: Recorded drug-trafficking offences per 100 residents in 2025. Enforcement intensity and recording practices strongly affect territorial comparisons.

lenses.name: Sexual violence
lenses.description: Recorded sexual violence per 100 residents in 2025. This is recorded crime, not victimization prevalence; reporting propensity varies substantially.

lenses.name: Property damage
lenses.description: Recorded intentional destruction and property damage per 100 residents in 2025. Recorded crime reflects reporting propensity and police recording practices as well as offending.

lenses.name: Primary schools
lenses.description: Open schools classified as Ecole in the current Ministry directory, per 10,000 department residents.

lenses.name: Collèges & lycées
lenses.description: Open Collège and Lycée establishments in the current Ministry directory, per 10,000 department residents.

lenses.name: Everyday services
lenses.description: Population-weighted number of six everyday service categories present in communes: food shops, pharmacy, general practitioner, primary school, post office/relais and library. INSEE BPE 2024.

lenses.name: Food shops
lenses.description: Food retailers counted in the INSEE Base permanente des équipements 2024, per 10,000 residents. Commune counts are aggregated by map hex.

lenses.name: Pharmacies
lenses.description: Pharmacies counted in the INSEE Base permanente des équipements 2024, per 10,000 residents.

lenses.name: Sports & culture
lenses.description: Sports, leisure and cultural facilities counted in the INSEE Base permanente des équipements 2024, per 10,000 residents. Counts reflect facility records, not floor area or quality.

lenses.name: Hospital services
lenses.description: Hospital and specialized health-service records in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Multiple service types can belong to the same hospital, so this measures recorded service presence rather than hospital count or capacity.

lenses.name: Childcare facilities
lenses.description: Young-childcare establishments and micro-crèches in INSEE BPE 2024 per 10,000 residents. The denominator is total population, not the target under-3 population.

lenses.name: Eldercare services
lenses.description: Elderly housing, home-care and support-service records in INSEE BPE 2024 per 10,000 residents. Counts reflect service records, not beds or capacity.

lenses.name: Cinemas
lenses.description: Cinema records in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Counts reflect BPE equipment records, not admissions or screen quality.

lenses.name: Swimming pools
lenses.description: Swimming-pool facility records in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Counts reflect facility records, not water area, public opening hours or quality.

lenses.name: Rail stations
lenses.description: Passenger rail stations of national, regional or local interest in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Station count does not measure train frequency or service quality.

lenses.name: Postal access points
lenses.description: Post offices, postal agencies and relais poste in INSEE BPE 2024 per 10,000 residents. Access-point density does not capture opening hours or service range.

lenses.name: Libraries
lenses.description: Libraries in INSEE BPE 2024 per 10,000 residents. Counts reflect BPE equipment records, not collection size, opening hours or digital services.

lenses.name: France Services
lenses.description: France Services one-stop public-service centers in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Presence does not measure the range or quality of services available on site.

lenses.name: Recycling centers
lenses.description: Déchèteries in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Counts reflect staffed waste-drop-off facility records, not capacity, accepted materials or opening hours.

lenses.name: Police & gendarmerie
lenses.description: Police and gendarmerie stations in INSEE BPE 2024 per 100,000 residents. Station density does not measure staffing, response times or territorial coverage quality.
